name: movie-tv-data-extractor
title: Movie & TV Data Extractor (All-in-One)
description: Nine movie and TV extractors in one, on TMDB's official API. Paste IMDb ids, TMDB links or just names. Cast, crew, budget and revenue; full filmographies; every episode with its own rating; reviews with scores; genre and year search; charts. Optional Markdown output for RAG.
